home.label: Custom bridal
home.title: The atelier, reimagined.
home.body:
A Julie Sufi bridal gown begins with a vision. Yours.

From the first line drawn to the final fitting, each gown is conceived as a singular creation, designed exclusively for the woman who will wear it.

Working personally with Julie, your gown is shaped around your individuality, your silhouette and the way you wish to feel on your wedding day. Sculptural corsetry, refined proportions and fluid femininity come together with the intricate hand embroidery and embellishment that have become signatures of the Julie Sufi house.

Within our family atelier, three generations of craftsmanship come together to create every gown.
Here, time honoured techniques are entrusted to specialist artisans who work meticulously by hand. 

Fine glass beads are individually placed. Embroidered motifs are built stitch by stitch. Corsetry is sculpted to the body. Every seam, fastening and finishing detail is considered with precision.
It is a process defined by patience, artistry and an uncompromising attention to detail.

No two Julie Sufi brides are the same.

Neither are their gowns.

Depending on the intricacy of the design and the level of handwork required, a bespoke Julie Sufi gown may take between six weeks and twelve months to complete.

Custom bridal gowns begin from $7,000 AUD, inclusive of fabrics and all required fittings.

Your experience begins with a private design consultation with Julie.

This is an opportunity to discover your vision together, exploring silhouette, fabrication, embellishment and the details that will make the gown unmistakably yours.

Should you prefer to speak with our atelier before making an appointment, we invite you to contact us via direct message or email. A member of the Julie Sufi team will be delighted to assist you.

panels.label: About us
panels.title: Meet the designer
panels.body:
Meet the Designer

Julie Sufi is an Australian couture bridal designer whose work is shaped by three generations of craftsmanship, embroidery and artistry.

After studying at the Melbourne School of Fashion, Julie began her design career in 2010, continuing a family tradition established by her parents and grandparents. Today, her collections are created within the family atelier, where generations of knowledge and traditional handcraft continue to inform every piece.

Known for intricate hand embroidery, sculptural silhouettes and refined couture construction, Julie approaches bridal design with a distinctly modern sensibility. Her work balances structure with softness, celebrating the female form through considered proportions, movement and exceptional detail.

Each gown begins with a sketch and is brought to life through hours of meticulous handwork. Glass beading, embroidery and carefully selected fabrics are transformed by skilled artisans into pieces designed to feel as extraordinary as the women who wear them.

For Julie, couture is deeply personal. It is the preservation of slow fashion, shown in craftsmanship and couture techniques passed down from one generation to the next, reimagined through a contemporary lens.

Following the presentation of her collections at New York Bridal Fashion Week, Julie Sufi continues to bring this heritage to an international audience, creating gowns defined by artistry, individuality and enduring beauty.

panels.title: Privacy Policy
panels.body:
JULIE SUFI recognizes the importance of protecting the privacy of all visitors to the JULIE SUFI website. The following explains how we handle information that we learn about you when you visit our site.

PERSONALLY IDENTIFIABLE INFORMATION

Personally identifiable information, including names, addresses, e-mails and the like, is collected on this website only when it is voluntarily provided by a visitor to our site. BELLUCCIO shall not knowingly provide your name, address and e-mail to any third party without your prior consent unless ordered to do so by a court or other governmental agency.

COLLECTING DATA

The JULIE SUFI website may deposit "cookies" in a visitor's computer. Cookies are pieces of information that a website transfers to an individual's hard drive for record keeping purposes. Cookies are only sent back to the website that deposited them when a visitor returns to that site. Cookies make it easier for you by saving your preferences while you are at our site. We never save passwords, credit card information or other personal identifiable information in cookies.

Most web browsers are initially set up to accept cookies. You can, however, reset your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent.

INFORMATION REMOVAL

If you prefer not to receive information from us, please send us an e-mail at contact@juliesufi.com. Please include your name and e-mail address and any message.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Transmission of data over the Internet is never guaranteed to be completely secure. It is possible that third parties not under the control of JULIE SUFI may be able to access or intercept transmissions or private communications without JULIE SUFI' permission or knowledge. JULIE SUFI takes all steps possible to protect your personal information. However, we cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us. Such transmissions are done at your own risk.

JULIE SUFI shall not, under any circumstances, including but not limited to negligence, be liable for any special, incidental or consequential damages that result from the disclosure or use of the information or materials on this site.

JULIE SUFI reserves the right to change this Privacy Policy at any time. Any such changes shall be posted on this site.

panels.label: Return Policy
panels.title: Return Policy
panels.body:
Returns on merchandise that is damaged or defective are accepted. An email must be sent to the JULIE SUFI representative advising discovery of the fault and all returns must be made within 24 hours of the item being taken from the store due to the nature of the garments being delicate and specialised. The garment cannot be returned after this 24 hour grace period.

Returns on special ordered plus size gowns or specialty ordered gowns such as custom made gowns, special measurement gowns, rush delivery gowns or discontinued gowns are not accepted.

Refunds are not provided for change of mind.

Transportation cost of the return is not assumed by JULIE SUFI.

All returned gowns will have a 50% restocking fee applied from the full purchase price of the gown. This amount will be deducted from the gown refund.
